title: Comparison of completed Koszul and quotient derived limits
statement: For a completed adic coefficient datum d on A and a finite family a generating d.ideal, the explicit completed Koszul derived functor is naturally isomorphic to the derived strict quotient inverse-limit functor, and this isomorphism carries the explicit Koszul unit to the independently normalized quotient completion unit.

source.place: Tag 099M, together with Tag 0941 and Algebraization Tag 091N

proof.text: Restrict the derived categories to K-flat representatives, use right-fraction density and localization descent, and form the comparison from the completed strict Koszul-to-quotient Roos augmentation and the normalized Roos derived-limit comparison.

The augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism on K-flat models and the reduction counit is invertible there; therefore the descended comparison is an isomorphism. Its unit equality follows from the chain augmentation equation, the Roos normalization, and the chosen K-flat formula for the quotient completion unit.

The generic localization assembly reflects isomorphisms under fully faithful precomposition, and extends the unit equality from the K-flat subcategory using localization faithfulness. Its two helper theorems are proved from Mathlib.
